description: Complete an ORDINARY task on behalf of a worker. Inserts a completion record and timer event. Coordination-cycle tasks (a CODE:/REVIEW: build or review, a Decision / Question / Integrate / Parked card on a project Decisions list — tasks that carry `coord`) are refused with 403 for every key tier: builds and reviews are completed by their runner, decisions only by the human on the worker page. SR-S2 rules (SR-API3): a key with an agent_id completes only as its own agent_registry worker (any other worker: 403 worker_not_key_owner); a key without one completes on behalf of the named worker (on_behalf_of, or worker_id) only when it is an owner/admin-tier root key, and the completion records on_behalf_of (actor and worker). A delegated key without an agent_id: 403 on_behalf_requires_owner_key.

on_behalf_of.description: Worker ID the completion is done on behalf of (for an owner/admin-tier key the same as worker_id; recorded)

worker_id.description: Worker ID the completion is recorded for (an agent key: omit it, or pass its own worker)

name: tascan_complete_task
